in_english.name: Reginald
in_english.long_meaning: The name Reginald is derived from the Old German words 'regin' (ruler) and 'wald' (rule). It means 'ruler of the castle' or 'powerful ruler'. The name was popular in Europe during the Middle Ages.

data.cultural_impact: Reinaldos was a prominent name during the medieval period in Europe, as many Christian rulers bore this name. The name carried a sense of power, leadership, and strength. It was often given to boys suspected to inherit royal or noble blood and expected to rule with wisdom and determination.

This name serves as a reminder of the spiritual responsibility to lead with love, compassion, and the fear of God.
